After USDA revises an item for a marketing year, how often its next revision of that item goes the same way. Well above 50% means revisions trend: USDA moves toward the final number in steps.

Condition yield model

Leave-one-year-out over 29 years, condition at week 34: mean abs error 4.37 bu/ac vs 6.54 for trend alone; direction vs trend right 72% of years. On the 17 years where USDA had a yield forecast out by that date: model 4.41 vs USDA 3.62 bu/ac.

Export pace

Pace-implied exports at this point of the season: mean abs error 23.93% of final vs 21.48% for USDA's same-month forecast; called the direction of USDA's next export revision 65% of the time (n=10).

Does export pace predict price?

Pace-implied minus USDA exports (weeks 12+, MY 2010 on) vs the roll-adjusted front-month move over the next 4 weeks: correlation -0.022; when pace ran 5%+ away from USDA, price moved in the pace direction 49% of the time (n=265 weekly readings, overlapping).

Price reaction to WASDE

Ending-stocks revision vs front-month move over WASDE week: correlation -0.04, price moved opposite to the stocks revision 56% of the time (n=132; approximate: window return over WASDE week (exact release dates not used)).
